title: POS-Signature Demonstration Retrieval for In-Context Dependency Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2610.31966v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Demonstrations for in-context learning are often retrieved by semantic similarity, which may be a poor proxy for relevance in structured prediction. We study demonstration selection for Universal Dependencies parsing with a POS-signature policy that represents sentences with weighted part-of-speech statistics and retrieves three length-compatible, gold-parsed examples from the labeled training split. We evaluate two open-weight language models without fine-tuning on all 2,077 sentences of the UD English Web Treebank test set, comparing the policy with shot- and format-matched fixed and semantic three-shot baselines, as well as zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and critique-refinement systems. POS-signature retrieval yields the highest labeled attachment score among the tested prompting systems for both models (72.4 and 73.2), outperforming semantic retrieval by 1.9 and 2.7 points; paired-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals exclude zero for bot

translated_title: 基于词性签名的上下文依存句法分析示例检索
translated_abstract: 上下文学习的示例通常通过语义相似度来检索，但这种方法在结构化预测任务中可能是相关性的一个很差的代理指标。我们研究了通用依存分析（Universal Dependencies parsing）中的示例选择问题，提出了一种词性签名（POS-signature）策略：使用加权词性统计来表示句子，并从带标注的训练集中检索三个长度兼容、附带标准解析的示例。我们在 UD 英语网页树库（English Web Treebank）测试集的全部 2,077 个句子上，对两个未经微调的开源权重语言模型进行了评估，将该策略与匹配示例数量和格式的固定三示例基线、语义检索三示例基线，以及零样本、思维链和批判式改进系统进行了比较。词性签名检索在所有被测试的提示系统中为两个模型都取得了最高的标注依存分数（72.4 和 73.2），分别比语义检索高出 1.9 和 2.7 个百分点；配对自助法的 95% 置信区间排除了零差异（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于加权词性统计的"词性签名"示例检索策略，为上下文依存句法分析选取更相关的演示示例，无需微调即在两个开源语言模型上超越了语义相似度检索等基线方法，取得了最高的标注依存分数。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a POS-signature demonstration retrieval policy that represents sentences with weighted part-of-speech statistics to select in-context examples for dependency parsing, achieving the highest labeled attachment scores without fine-tuning and outperforming semantic-similarity retrieval and other prompting baselines on two open-weight language models.
